one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-30. The Trump-Xi Washington summit (Sep 23-25) already happened and produced a two-month extension of the rare-earth truce rather than a new deal, so the next truce cliff falls around late November, outside the window. Q3 2026 results are listed for Oct 29 after close by one aggregator (TipRanks) but Nov 5 by another; last year Q3 came Nov 6, so I put roughly 50% on earnings landing inside the window. Management already guided Q3 NdPr production above 1,000 t, so volume is largely priced; the swing factor is realized NdPr pricing vs the $110/kg DoD floor (China spot ~$97/kg in early Sep) and PPA income, which I see as roughly symmetric. Small overhang from China Rare Earth Group talks to buy Shenghe (~3% MP holder). With no clear directional edge I use a near-symmetric lognormal centred at ~$47 (Oct 1 trading ~$46.7) with monthly sigma ~0.22 (74% annual / 3.5, nudged up for recent 80%+ realized vol and the possible earnings print).

inputs_detail.derivation: ~10% haircut to $451.5M 2027 consensus: Q2 2026 annualized adj. EBITDA is only ~$114M and MP's history (2021-24) shows ramp timelines slipping; partly offset by the $110/kg DoD NdPr floor which protects Materials-segment margin.

Lynas, the only scaled non-China peer, trades ~46x trailing EV/EBITDA on cyclically depressed earnings; I apply roughly half that to a forward, de-risked (floor-supported) EBITDA, above commodity-miner 8-10x for the DoD-backed strategic premium.
Jun 30 2026 cash+ST investments $1,452.6M less LT debt $934.6M = $518M; assume ~$0.2B net burn on 10X/Independence capex after DoD funding over the next 12 months.
178.05M common outstanding (Jun 30 2026) + DoD Series A preferred ($428M liquidation pref convertible at $30.03, ~14M shares) + DoD warrants (~11M at $30.03), both in the money at current price.
Rolling forward from $0.87 (2027) toward 2028 as Independence magnet sales scale; held below a full 2028 roll because 10X commissioning (and its $140M guaranteed EBITDA) is 2028+.
Lynas trades ~63x trailing P/E near its 2-year low; MP has traded at very high multiples on near-zero earnings since 2022; I haircut to 50x as earnings normalize.

bear.story: US-China truce extended/normalized and Chinese NdPr eases further below $110; floor protects revenue but market stops paying a scarcity premium; magnet qualification/10X slips, earnings miss 2027 consensus by a wide margin. Stock reverts toward the pre-DoD-deal (Jun 2025) ~$22-33 range, similar to the 2022-24 post-boom drawdown (-75% peak to trough).

base.story: NdPr production at 1,000-1,300 t/q, DoD floor and PPA income keep Materials profitable, Independence magnets ramp, 2027 EPS ~$0.7-0.9. Stock trades in the $40-60 range it has held for most of the last 12 months, valued ~22x EBITDA.

bull.story: Truce lapses or China re-escalates (new export controls/blacklists as in Jun-Jul 2026), NdPr back above $110, heavy rare-earth (Dy/Tb/Gd/Sm) offtakes and drone/defense demand re-rate MP as the sole scaled US mine-to-magnet platform; revisits the 2025-26 $70-100 spike levels.

thesis_break_reason: ~$30 is the DoD preferred/warrant conversion price and roughly where MP traded before the July 2025 DoD partnership; trading there would imply the market is giving no value to the price floor, guaranteed 10X EBITDA and downstream build-out, i.e. a fundamental problem (floor/ partnership renegotiation, magnet qualification failure, major cost overrun or equity raise) rather than ordinary 74%-vol noise.

reasoning: Base-rate lane. (1) MP's own history (Twelve Data monthly closes Jun 2020-Sep 2026): realized vol ~73% annualized (last 15 months ~83%); across 63 rolling 12-month windows the median return was +4%, 10th pct -47%, 25th -29%, 75th +104%, 90th +205%; 24% of windows fell >30% and 35% rose >50%. The fat right tail comes from policy spikes (late-2020/21 and mid-2025 DoD deal); the left tail from the 2022-24 post-boom unwind (-75% from peak). The setup today resembles the post-spike consolidation phase: -53% from the Oct 2025 $100 high, range $38-66 for most of 2026. (2) Peer: Lynas also -45% from its 2026 high, still ~46x EV/EBITDA - the whole non-China group de-rated together, so this is a sector/policy-premium cycle, not MP-specific failure. (3) Event odds: Manifold gives 82% that China's suspension of its Oct-2025 controls persists through Nov 30 2026 and only 9% that April-2025 heavy-RE licensing is lifted by end-2026 (thin play-money markets); Polymarket prices 78.5% on a 5-15% US tariff on China at end-2026 (~$8.7k volume). Sep summit produced only a two-month truce extension. So the modal path is managed tension: no big re-escalation spike, no full normalization - consistent with range trading. (4) Fundamentals: Q2 2026 revenue+PPA $126M, adj. EBITDA $28.5M, net cash ~$0.5B; DoD $110/kg floor (China spot ~$97/kg) caps downside on Materials. Fair value ~$47 (EV/EBITDA $44.8, P/E $50), essentially today's price; sell-side mean target $74 (19 analysts) is treated as an optimistic bias rather than an anchor. (5) Ladder: mixture of a lognormal centred at $46 (sigma 0.62) with 20% weight on a wider, slightly higher-centred component (sigma 0.95, $52) to reproduce MP's skewed history; lower tail trimmed modestly because of the floor, $1.45B cash and DoD equity backing (book ~$11/share). Median ~$47, mean ~$52. Research limited: Alpha Vantage rate-limited, Twelve Data estimates gated, Polymarket front-end not fetchable (used public gamma API), X not attempted.
